name: pi-suite
description: Loop-engineering toolkit for pi — pi-quest (autonomous project manager), pi-todo (task ledger), pi-memory (project/user memory), pi-minions (subagent execution), and pi-agent (performance dashboard), sharing one cross-extension contract.
author: Dimas Victor

scripts.test: npm run test:node && npm run test:subagent
scripts.test:node: node --import tsx --import ./test/isolate-home.ts --test core/*.test.ts extensions/quest/*.test.ts extensions/todo/*.test.ts extensions/memory/*.test.ts extensions/agent/*.test.ts bench/*.test.ts
